data.title: Bitcoin Slides to $80,000 as Ethereum, XRP, Dogecoin Trigger $1B Liquidation Cascade
data.description: Bitcoin fell 3% to $80,000 amid Iran tensions and AI security fears. Experts see the drop as a healthy retest and crypto is entering a tokenization super cycle. Recent higher high and BTC's recovery above major moving averages suggest the broader bearish trend may be ending.
data.author: Khyathi Dalal
